text:
Power is 31% over budget, while delay has about 36% margin. I'll trade some of that delay margin for power. The static current (iref + Itail + I2 ≈ 17 µA) accounts for about 31 µW. The rest probably comes from inverter shoot-through, made worse by the −6.5 mV systematic offset leaving o2 short of the rail. So I'll lower both currents and shrink the inverter with a cheap refine.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Topology works and delay has 36% margin; power is 31% over. Cut Itail and I2 and shrink the inverter to cut static and shoot-through current. Higher gm/Id on the input keeps the preamp gain up at the lower current.",
 "params": {"gmid_in": 18, "L_in": 0.25, "gmid_ld": 9, "L_ld": 0.25, "Itail": 4e-6, "I2": 4.5e-6, "Winv": 0.42},
 "bounds": {"Itail": [2e-6, 6e-6], "I2": [2.5e-6, 6e-6], "Winv": [0.42, 0.8], "L_in": [0.15, 0.5], "L_ld": [0.15, 0.5]}}
```
